SHOT: Worn ring frame, 4:5: the BACK OF ONE HAND held up flat and square to camera in front of the collarbone, fingers together and relaxed, the camera brought close so the ring on the ring finger is legible at its true small size.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: hand, fingers, wrist, collarbone and shoulder.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn on the RING FINGER only (the fourth finger), the two clusters side by side across the top of the finger, one toward each side, facing each other over a narrow gap that runs along the finger: one cluster a clear PEAR beside a clear ROUND stone, the other two clear PEARS side by side with a row of tiny gold beads beside them, exactly as IMAGE 1 shows; any other jewellery in IMAGE 2 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN CLUSTER RING: a broad polished gold band about 4mm wide that does NOT close; each open end carries a small cluster of clear faceted stones in raised gold claws on a gold base, and the two clusters face each other across a narrow gap. One end: ONE clear PEAR beside ONE clear round stone. The other end: TWO clear PEAR stones side by side, their rounded ends together and their points turned outward, with a row of tiny gold beads along the edge of the band beside them. All stones clear. Only clear stones: one pear and one round on one end, two pears on the other; never coloured stones, never a full pave band, never a closed band. Exactly FOUR stones in all: three pears and one small round; never five stones, never four pears, never two rounds.

SCALE TEST: On the finger the two clusters sit SIDE BY SIDE across the top of the finger, one toward each side of it, facing each other over a narrow gap that runs ALONG the finger; in each cluster the two stones line up along the finger, one nearer the knuckle and one nearer the nail; never one cluster in front of the other along the finger; each cluster about two thirds of the finger's width long, never wider than the finger. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.
